input.title: Add an accessible name to the search field
input.rationale: The search input (line 8) has no accessible name: there is no <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby or title. Screen reader users would hear only "search, edit text" without knowing what the field is for. The form already has role="search" and its submit button says "Search", so aria-label="Search" names the field to match the visible button without changing the layout. A visible <label> would be better for sighted users, but that needs a markup change, which is outside the attribute-only edits allowed here. A reviewer should confirm the wording and run the check again.
